summary: Mobile Expo AI Tools hub + all 6 AI tool screens tested end-to-end after login as cathy@example.com. Hub cards route correctly to /tool/{slug}; every tool submits, hits the shared /api/public/* endpoint, and renders the expected result blocks. sanitizeAI() output is clean, no em/en dashes or space-hyphen-space found in any AI-generated text (letter, summary, gaps, questions, assessment, caveat, streams_note). Dark theme renders with legible high-contrast text. One minor UX gap found: the letters tool does not handle the backend abuse-guardrail payload ({abuse_flag, abuse_response}) so the Result card renders empty when the LLM refuses (reproduced with a 'clinical' prompt). Also noted: the ` - ` used as a numeric-range separator in the mobile UI (Provider Price Checker and Classification Self-Check result rows) is a UI string, not AI text, but strictly speaking still contains a dash character — flagged as a code review nit.

ui_bugs.issue: When the backend returns an abuse-guardrail payload like {abuse_flag: 'clinical', abuse_response: '...'} (no `letter` field), the mobile Result card renders only the 'Result' heading with an empty body — the guardrail message is dropped. Reproduced with participant_name='Dorothy' + changes_summary='Mobility has declined; needs more personal care and physio.' → HTTP 200 body: {"abuse_flag":"clinical","abuse_response":"That's a question for the GP / care team. Want help drafting a question to ask them instead?"}. Reference: /app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx:257-261. Suggest: render data.abuse_response (via sanitizeAI) as a soft-warn block when data.letter is absent — same treatment should be applied to the other tools that can trip guardrails.

issues: Numeric ranges are rendered as `${money(lower)} - ${money(upper)}` (with space-hyphen-space) in /app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx:238 and :246. This is UI code, not AI text, so sanitizeAI() does not touch it, but the Wayly 'no dashes' style rule is violated in the surfaced string. Consider `${money(lower)} to ${money(upper)}` or an en-dash-with-no-spaces to align with the web copy convention.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted repeatedly on tool screens. Non-blocking but worth migrating for RN Web parity.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; likely from a shared UI primitive.

action_items: In /app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx letters-and-follow-ups result branch, handle data.abuse_response / abuse_flag when data.letter is missing (render the guardrail message via sanitizeAI). Consider generalising this to a shared fallback for all 6 tools.

Replace ` - ` numeric range separators in the mobile ToolResult (Provider Price Checker and Classification Self-Check) with a non-dash separator (e.g. ' to ') to comply with the 'no dashes' Wayly copy rule end-to-end.

Fix the dead branch on /app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx:95 — `if (f.key === 'current_lifetime_balance' && v == null) v = 0;` never fires because the field default is empty string, so `v == null` is false. Either compare with `(v === '' || v == null)` or move the guard after the number coercion on line 94.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx:95 default-to-0 guard for current_lifetime_balance is dead code (empty string is falsy but not == null). Backend happens to default to 0 so nothing breaks today, but the intent is not being honoured.
/app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx:257-261 letters branch has no fallback for the backend's abuse_flag/abuse_response payload — users see an empty Result card silently.
/app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx:238,246 hard-coded ` - ` between money(lower) and money(upper) violates the 'no dashes' copy rule surfaced to the user.
Mobile logs show deprecated `shadow*` and `props.pointerEvents` warnings; migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents at the shared UI primitive level.

success_rate.frontend: 6/6 tool flows OK; 1 minor UX gap on guardrail fallback

test_credentials: cathy@example.com / testpass123 (caregiver, family plan). Login testids: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expo web preview URL for this env: https://proration-preview.expo.preview.emergentagent.com. AI-Tools tab is at /ai-tools; individual tools are at /tool/{slug}. Tool testids: tool-{slug} on hub cards; tool-submit, tool-result, tool-field-{key}, tool-field-{key}-{value} (chip), tool-scale-{i}-{n} (12x5 grid), tool-letter-text on the letter body. AI text passes through sanitizeAI(); range separators are hard-coded UI strings and bypass it. Note: the letters endpoint returns 200 with an `abuse_flag/abuse_response` payload when the input looks like a medical/clinical question — the mobile UI currently drops that message.
rca of the issue: letters-and-follow-ups renders `sanitizeAI(data.letter)` unconditionally at [slug].tsx:259. When the backend guardrail returns `{abuse_flag, abuse_response}` (no `letter` field), `data.letter` is undefined and sanitizeAI('') returns '', so a blank Text node is drawn inside the Result card. Fix: `data.letter ? <letter block> : data.abuse_response ? <guardrail block via sanitizeAI> : null`.
